title: Spent way too long building a financial database,using ai to do things with it..
author: boss-man-007
selftext:
To the quants who'll bash this: yeah, not quant-shop data. No tick data, no order book, no satellite feeds  that's six figures a year with a data team attached. Not trying to compete with that here. This is for retail algo traders and learners who don't have that budget. If you want institutional-grade data, this isn't for you, and that's fair.

What's in there

|Asset Class|Coverage|Range|Granularity|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|US Equities|353 tickers|1927–2026|Daily|
|China Equities|4,049 tickers|2000–2026|Daily|
|India Equities|3,036 tickers|1999–2026|Daily|
|Intl Equities|556 tickers|1986–2026|Daily|
|FX (majors)|6 pairs|2000–2026|1-min|
|Crypto|BTC/ETH/SOL|2012–2026|1-min|
|Futures|542 contracts|1959–2026|Mixed|
|COT Positioning|1,097 markets|1986–2026|Weekly|
|13F Holdings|13,109 filers|1987–2026|Quarterly|
|Macro|US/UK/EU/Japan + global|1854–2026|Varies|
|Volatility|VIX, MOVE, SKEW|1990–2026|Daily|
|Factor Returns|Fama-French|1926–2026|Daily|

**\~422M rows, \~34GB**

  
Wanted to show something instead of just talking. Hooked it up to OpenCode, pulled EUR/USD, the S&P 500, and a China equity proxy onto one calendar, and charted 90-day rolling correlation across all three. Recorded it

Took about 5 minutes. Doing this the normal way, three paid APIs, mismatched schemas, different rate limits, exchange calendars that don't even share holidays, is a full day if you're already set up, or 1-3 weeks from scratch. China equity data alone is a pain to source solo. Zero API calls here, just querying my own drive.

The chart itself isn't a discovery, it's a starting point. What changed is how fast you can ask the question, weeks down to minutes. Doesn't skip the real validation work, just removes the wall that stops most people from starting.

. Curious what others have built, and what you'd test with it.

comments.author: cybersarcasm
comments.body:
I have built the same thing but for every trading aspect and decades of data for each symbol (crypto, stocks, trades etc..) live and delisted, while adding new IPOS, no AI assistance. It was definitely a challenge, but the algorithm I designed is working for the US markets only for a solid data feed. However I am slowly doing the same for each region across the board. I just started the model training three months ago. I have no simulation paradox and am hitting near perfect accuracy, however since I verified I have solid clean data/data history I am starting the paper model training to see if I can hit near 80% after ten months. 

All in all I should have added this method as well. Maybe in the coming months. Good work!!
